title: Connect service activity to costs and billing

scenes.title: Connect service activity to costs and billing
scenes.narration: Welcome to Resgrid Academy. In this lesson, we will connect service activity to costs and billing. Re-entering activity into estimates, invoices, and cost spreadsheets creates inconsistent rates and missed supporting evidence. We will explain the features, the setup decisions, and a practical way to check the result.

scenes.title: A department scenario
scenes.narration: An event standby is invoiced from its deployment record, and a mutual-aid claim is prepared for MARS reimbursement. Bill for standby and contract services and prepare reimbursement claims from records you already keep. The examples in this series use a fictional department and are teaching scenarios, not default settings.

scenes.title: Invoices

scenes.title: Contracts

scenes.title: Business Operations
scenes.narration: Business Operations. The Workforce and Business Operations add-on: invoicing, payments, contracts, bids, MARS reimbursement and workforce costing. Certifications and Deployment Finance do not require this add-on. Pay-data reporting additionally needs ADP Enabled; online payments require provider setup. No reimbursement or savings are guaranteed. Availability also depends on Business Operations. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Configure one useful workflow
scenes.narration: For the training scenario, work in this order. Step 1. Confirm Business Operations access and configure billing identity and approved rates. Step 2. Prepare a demo bid or contract and the corresponding service invoice. Step 3. Review payments, invoice aging, deployment costs, or MARS claim evidence as applicable.

scenes.title: Verify the result
scenes.narration: Now verify the result. Reconcile source activity, quantities, rates, totals, and recorded payment or claim outcomes. Use a payment-provider test environment. A common problem to watch for: Pay-data reporting also requires enabled Advanced Data Protection. Annual rates and reporting requirements need current finance review.

scenes.title: Try it with your department
scenes.narration: Your practice task is simple. Prepare a standby estimate and draft invoice from sample activity. Compare recorded cost with the billed amount and explain any difference. Record the result, who owns the follow-up, and when it should be reviewed.
